messages:
Alex: Noticed a handful of inconsistencies on the API ref for POST /v1/generate: request params, an example response, and the streaming snippet don't match the OpenAPI. Docs CI flagged it. Can someone own a quick sweep?

Nora: I can take it. Which mismatches specifically?

Alex: 1) Examples use 'text' top-level in response; OpenAPI shows 'outputs'. 2) Request examples send 'prompt' but runtime expects 'input'. 3) Streaming snippet shows raw JSON lines but our SSE implementation emits named events (chunk/done).

DevEx-bot: automated note: docs CI failure -> /lint/docs: api-reference/generate.md (schema mismatch). See job logs: https://ci.redwood.ai/jobs/2345

Nora: Plan: update the API ref page to match runtime (use 'choices' array for responses), replace 'prompt' -> 'input' in curl/python/node snippets, and add a short "Streaming responses" subsection describing named SSE events. Will open branch docs/generate-cleanup.

Chris: Heads-up: changing the OpenAPI will affect our generated SDK snippets. After the update we need to re-run the snippet generator and paste new samples in examples/snippets. I can handle the generation step.

Yuki: Also add a tiny migration note showing old->new payload mapping. Customers often grep for 'prompt' and miss the change. Suggest one-liner at top: "Compatibility: field 'prompt' renamed to 'input' (see migration example)."

Nora: Draft SSE example to include in the page:
```
# curl example (SSE)
curl -N -H "Accept: text/event-stream" -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \
  -d '{"input":"Tell me a joke","stream":true}' \
  https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate
# server sends lines:
event: chunk
data: {"delta":"Why did the"}
event: chunk
data: {"delta":" chicken cross"}
event: chunk
data: {"delta":" the road?"}
event: done
data: {"id":"rpt_01","status":"complete"}
```

Chris: Once Nora updates the OpenAPI and page, I'll run the generator and commit updated snippets. Reminder: pin generator to v0.9.2 to avoid local version drift.

DevEx-bot: linked issue #2204 -> PR 5342 opened by Nora (label: docs:needs-review)

Nora: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/5342 — changes: api-reference/generate.md, examples/snippets/generate_python.md, examples/snippets/generate_node.md, /docs/compatibility.md (one-line). Reviewers: @alex, @chris, @yuki. ETA: EOD today.

Alex: Thanks. Quick reviewer checklist: confirm OpenAPI passes 'make docs-validate', ensure python snippet runs with current SDK, and verify the SSE example shows event names. I'll review after lunch. :thumbsup:
